title: Signal: SQL built by concatenation (go) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on concatenated SQL in go code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: any concatenated query matches, including trusted assembly. Input trust needs human review.

examples.line: rows, err := db.Query(fmt.Sprintf("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '%s'", name))
rows, err := db.QueryContext(ctx, "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = $1", name)

fpNotes: Assembling fixed column lists or trusted fragments is the common false positive.
